jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
At PRODYNA, we design, implement, and operate modern cloud-native software and data platforms for mid- to large-sized enterprises. We help our customers unlock the value of their data through scalable architectures, advanced analytics, and cloud technologies while delivering future-proof solutions built on Microsoft Azure.
As part of our growing Data Engineering team in Athens, you will design and build enterprise-grade data platforms, modern Lakehouse architectures, and high-performance data pipelines that power analytics and AI workloads. Working closely with architects, software engineers, and cloud specialists, you'll help customers transform complex business requirements into reliable, scalable, and secure data solutions.
Your tasks
- Design, build and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Python, Apache Spark and Azure Databricks. Design, build and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Python, Apache Spark and Azure Databricks.
- Develop modern ETL/ELT architectures capable of processing large-scale enterprise datasets.
- Design and implement Lakehouse solutions using Delta Lake and other modern table formats.
- Build robust APIs and data services for internal and external consumers.
- Optimize Spark applications through performance tuning, partitioning strategies and bottleneck analysis.
- Implement dimensional data models, Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), schema evolution and data quality controls.
- Develop real-time streaming solutions using Spark Structured Streaming.
- Collaborate with Cloud Architects and Software Engineers to design end-to-end Azure-based data platforms.
- Build Infrastructure as Code using Terraform/Terragrunt and support CI/CD automation.
- Ensure observability through logging, monitoring and operational metrics.
- Apply security best practices including encryption, secrets management and protection of sensitive data.
- Participate in customer workshops, architecture discussions and technical consulting activities.
Your profile
- 6+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering.
- Proven experience designing enterprise-scale data platforms.
- Deep expertise in Spark performance optimization.
- Strong experience with streaming architectures and Spark Structured Streaming.
- Experience with Lakehouse technologies such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi.
- Advanced knowledge of data modeling, schema evolution and enterprise data architecture.
- Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform/Terragrunt.
- Knowledge of observability, monitoring and production operations.
- Strong understanding of security, encryption, key management and GDPR/PII handling.
- Ability to mentor engineers and provide technical leadership.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and stakeholders.
- Fluency in English.
Why PRODYNA
- Continuous learning & professional development with a dedicated budget
- 25 vacation days with a permanent contract from day one
- Free hardware selection
- Private health & life insurance
- Health & wellbeing initiatives, from marathon participation to wellness challenges that keep us active and motivated
- Team events & social activities, from our global Christmas party to team hikes and other memorable experiences
- Global network: Collaborate with international clients and colleagues across countries and cultures
- Office refreshments: Enjoy lunch, snacks, and fresh fruit in the office
- Employee referral bonus: Recommend great talent, grow our team, and earn a bonus for successful referrals

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a place where a can-do attitude, strong team spirit, and innovation define the way you work? We validate and implement cutting-edge technologies, creating tailored solutions that help our customers succeed. We foster a culture of innovation, continuously embracing emerging technologies and challenging ourselves to find better ways forward. We have the courage to stand up for the best solution and the honesty to speak openly with our clients and colleagues. We believe that collaboration is our greatest strength, because achieving exceptional results takes collective effort. Join our team and help us shape the future together.
Your tasks
- Design, develop and maintain Java-based web applications for front-office insurance systems, applying object-oriented programming principles and modern web technologies and frameworks. The software you deliver is readable, maintainable and aligned with established coding standards, and is supported by automated unit, integration and end-to-end tests.
- Define technical specifications by understanding business requirements, breaking down problems, assessing impacted system components and identifying dependencies with other systems.
- Provide effort estimates for development tasks, taking into account complexity, risk and areas of uncertainty. Planning is carried out based on business priorities and team estimations.
- Identify and propose new technologies and tools that address business and technical challenges. You communicate ideas effectively within the team, present them clearly and help stakeholders understand their value and impact. You actively share knowledge within the team and across the organization.
- Create developer documentation and guidelines and contribute to user documentation when required. You maintain appropriate code comments, produce design documentation where necessary and develop training materials for fellow software engineers.
- Create and maintain build scripts that prepare software releases for test and production environments, and you author deployment plans to be executed by IT Operations.
Your profile
- BSc or MSc in Computing/Mathematics/Engineering.
- Experience in Java web development using frameworks such as JSP, JSF, Apache Struts, GWT or Apache Wicket.
- Preferably more than 5 years of working experience in software engineering.
- Excellent programming and software design skills.
- Solid understanding of distributed systems architecture.
- Solid working knowledge of web technologies, such as JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
- Basic knowledge of Agile/Scrum way of working.
- Strong analytical thinking.
- Experience in creating technical documentation, developer guidelines or training material.
- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
- Excellent knowledge of English language and German language is a super plus.
Why PRODYNA
- Continuous learning & professional development with a dedicated budget
- 25 vacation days with a permanent contract from day one
- Free hardware selection
- Private health & life insurance
- Health & wellbeing initiatives, from marathon participation to wellness challenges that keep us active and motivated
- Team events & social activities, from our global Christmas party to team hikes and other memorable experiences
- Global network: Collaborate with international clients and colleagues across countries and cultures
- Office refreshments: Enjoy lunch, snacks, and fresh fruit in the office
- Employee referral bonus: Recommend great talent, grow our team, and earn a bonus for successful referrals
